q: We use rooftop solar and grid power. What electricity factor do we give a buyer?
title: Electricity factor with solar and grid
short: Give the buyer your actual Scope 2: grid units bought times 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh. Solar you generate and use yourself has no grid emissions, so it lowers the total. Dividing by all units used gives a blended factor, but report kWh from each source too.
audience: MSMEs with rooftop solar answering buyer questionnaires

ul: Solar kWh from the inverter or generation meter.
Exported units, if net metered, kept separate.

p: If you export solar and import grid power at other times, count the grid units you imported, not the net figure on the bill, unless your method says otherwise.
Inverter reports and net meter readings for the year.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
